name: Third-Party SDK Auto-Bump Breaks API
description: Renovate opens a 'minor' bump for the auth SDK from 4.18 to 4.19. The release silently changes a default header from 'Authorization: Bearer ...' to 'X-Auth-Token: ...'. CI passes (mocks). In prod, every downstream call to the identity provider returns 401.
reasoning: Edge nginx → Node.js API → external IdP (modelled as a service). The simulation shows the identity provider returning 401 for the API right after deploy, which cascades into 5xx for users.

nodes.label: external-idp
nodes.notes: Auth0-style identity provider, called from saas-api on every request.

narrative.text: Healthy baseline. Renovate-merged PR queues for deploy.
Deploy goes live. Calls to external-idp now return 401 'Authorization header missing'.
saas-api 5xx rate jumps from 0.5% to 92%; LB passes errors back to clients.
On-call diffs the change set; SDK bump is the obvious suspect. Pin to 4.18.x.
Hot-fix deploy to revert SDK; auth flow restored.
All green. Action: contract test against the IdP in CI before any auth-SDK upgrade.

idp.note: the IdP is fine — we're calling it wrong
